commands.name: 查找记忆
commands.command:
curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1:8771/v1/memory/search?q={query_url}' | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
results = d.get('merged', d.get('results', []))
if not results:
    print('未找到相关记忆')
elif results and 'layer' in results[0]:
    for r in results[:8]:
        print(f\"——{r.get('layer','')} [{r.get('source','')}] {r.get('date','')} {r.get('title','')} [分{r.get('score',0)}]\")
        p = r.get('preview', r.get('snippet',''))[:200]
        print(p)
        print()
else:
    for r in results[:8]:
        print(f\"——[{r.get('section','')}] {r.get('match_line','')[:80]}\")
        print(r.get('snippet','')[:200])
        print()
"
commands.description: 三级级联搜索记忆：本地MEMORY.md → 日志索引 → Notion后备大脑，返回最相关结果摘要
